messages:
sarah: Quick sync: we saw a discrepancy in token tallies for 2026-04-06 morning window. Posting actions so we can move fast.
ajay: Noted. Ill prototype a playback re-ingest (idempotent) and a delta-report today. Plan to run a dry-run by 6pm PT.
maria: I'll pause invoice reissues until we confirm ledger totals. Will prepare refund/credit templates in case we need to issue quick credits.
kevin: I'll add alerting for 'token_reconcile_ratio' when >1.02 or <0.98 for a 1h rolling window. Also will run the token-sanity script now.
oliver: I'll add safe flags to the reprocess job (--max-rate, --dry-run, --idempotency-key) and document rollback steps.
billing-bot: Incident MTR-2026-04: ingestion backlog + dedupe discard -> undercount. Backfill recommended.
sarah: Root cause summary: nightly batch loader restarted under memory pressure -> some event files delayed -> aggregator dedupe triggered for late batches -> a subset of late events never applied.
ajay: Technical note: the dedupe comparator checks (customer_id, request_id) and expires after 5min. Late chunks coming in after compaction were considered duplicates due to tombstones.
kevin: SQL to surface affected customers (adjust window as needed):
```sql
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(raw_tokens) - COALESCE(SUM(ledger_tokens),0) AS missing
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN ledger_events l ON r.event_id = l.event_id
JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE r.event_ts >= '2026-04-06T03:00:00Z' AND r.event_ts < '2026-04-06T09:00:00Z'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING missing > 0
ORDER BY missing DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
maria: Good. I'll use that for the draft credit table. For accounts >$5k impact we'll do a manual signoff flow.
ajay: Reprocess plan (short):
- run replay dry-run with --idempotency-key=pm-mtr-2026-04-dry
- compare delta report (missing tokens per customer)
- if no duplicates apply, run replay with rate limit and monitor ledger growth
- mark tickets for customers with manual review if anomalies
I aim to post results by 2026-04-07 18:00 PT.
kevin: Added metric 'ingest.lag_seconds' + 'dedupe.discard_rate' to dashboard. Alert thresholds: lag >300s for 5m; discard_rate >0.01 for 15m.
oliver: Runbook updates I'll add:
- How to toggle dedupe window (config path + examples)
- Safe replay commands + expected counters to monitor
- How to abort an in-progress reprocess and clean partial writes
- Who to page (infra, platform) with pager escalation steps
I'll open PR by EOD Fri.
sarah: Consolidating owners & ETAs below. Reply 'owned' to confirm.
1) Playback re-ingest (dry-run + apply) -> ajay -> ETA 2026-04-07 18:00 PT
2) Invoice hold + credit template -> maria -> ETA 2026-04-07 12:00 PT
3) Telemetry + alerts -> kevin -> ETA 2026-04-09 09:00 PT
4) Runbook + rollback doc -> oliver -> ETA 2026-04-10 EOD
5) Postmortem writeup -> sarah -> ETA 2026-04-12
ajay: owned | will add a dry-run diff output and attach reconciliation CSV.
maria: owned | credit templates uploaded to drive and I'll link when ajay shares reconciliation CSV.
kevin: owned | alerts + dashboard tile merged; will paste link later in thread.
oliver: owned | PR when ready, will request review from sarah + ajay.
sarah: Decision: hold invoice reissues until ledger confirms. For emergency cases we'll issue manual credit memos and flag account teams.
ajay: Implementation note: re-ingest should use same idempotency keys as original pipeline to avoid duplicates. We'll canonicalize event IDs if needed.
kevin: Small test output from token-sanity run (sample):
```
customer_id | raw_total | ledger_total | ratio
------------+-----------+-------------+------
CUST-321    | 1245123   | 1244998     | 1.0010
CUST-19     | 99823     | 99123       | 1.0075
```
maria: If the ratio >1.005 for top 50 customers we'll queue a manual review.
sarah: Longer-term action: schedule a weekly reconciliation job that compares raw events -> ledger and alerts early. ajay, can you prototype next sprint?
ajay: Yep, will add a prototype to my backlog and aim for a PoC in sprint 2.
ops-bot: Scheduled job 'reconcile-weekly' created (cron: 0 2 * * 1) by ops.
sarah: Thanks everyone. Please tag your GH issues with 'postmortem/metering-playback' so we can roll up in the retro. I'll update this thread with links to PRs and the customer memo when ready. Closing for now.
ops-bot: Autoclose in 72h unless a new reply is posted.
